hodnota: 784 incidentu (56/den, SD 6,88), jen 8 se prekryva s alerty existujicich nastroju; 25,25 % malware nebo podezrele, 39,41 % poruseni politik, 35,33 % neznamy hlucny software
umisteni_a_citace: Sec. 4: '784 incidents, with an average of 56 incidents per day ... only eight incidents overlap'; '25.25% ... confirmed malware or suspicious'
poznamka: Jen ~1 ze 4 incidentu je malware/podezrele: 'neobvykle' neni 'skodlive'.

citace: Asad H., Adhikari S., Gashi I. A Perspective-Retrospective Analysis of Diversity in Signature-Based Open-Source NIDS
dataset: CIC-IDS2017 (6.7.: brute force, web, infiltrace), pravidla Snort a Suricata 2017-2020
hodnota: 1oo2: vyssi senzitivita, nizsi specificita nez oba; 2oo2: vyssi specificita, nizsi senzitivita nez jednotlive (ciselne hodnoty jen v obrazcich)
umisteni_a_citace: Sec. 5.2: '1OO2 systems are inherently more sensitive rather than specific, as we combine the alerts of both IDSs thus pushing both TPs and FPs upwards'
poznamka: Ciselne hodnoty nejsou v textu; zapsano kvalitativne.
